text_a: Guarda al menos tres copias de cada backup en el servidor.
text_b: Guarda no menos de tres copias de cada backup en el servidor.

text_a: Keep at least five days of logs on the server.
text_b: Keep no fewer than five days of logs on the server.

text_a: Envie no máximo 50 faturas por lote.
text_b: Envie no mínimo 50 faturas por lote.
what_differs: at most versus at least 50 invoices per batch

text_a: Limita los archivos adjuntos a 10 MB.
text_b: No adjuntes archivos de más de 10 MB.
what_differs: limit may apply to total attachments, while the second clearly applies to each file

text_a: Everyone except interns may access the payroll folder.
text_b: Everyone apart from interns may access the payroll folder.

text_a: Todos os servidores devem ser reiniciados, exceto o de banco de dados.
text_b: Todos os servidores devem ser reiniciados, com exceção do de banco de dados.

text_a: Todos los usuarios pueden editar el informe, excepto los becarios.
text_b: Todos los usuarios pueden editar el informe, incluidos los becarios.
what_differs: except versus including: interns excluded or included

text_a: Delete the temp files unless they are marked keep.
text_b: Delete the temp files if they are marked keep.
what_differs: unless versus if: keep-marked files are kept in A and deleted in B

text_a: Somente o administrador pode apagar backups antigos.
text_b: Apenas o administrador pode apagar backups antigos.

text_a: Solo el equipo de finanzas puede aprobar las facturas.
text_b: El equipo de finanzas también puede aprobar las facturas.
what_differs: only versus also: exclusivity removed

text_a: Only the IT team may restart the production server.
text_b: Just the IT team may restart the production server.

text_a: Solo los administradores pueden reiniciar servidores.
text_b: Solo los administradores reinician servidores.
what_differs: permission (pueden) versus habitual practice; the second may be a description rather than a rule

text_a: Do not share the admin password with anyone.
text_b: Never share the admin password with anyone.

text_a: No borres ningún archivo sin aprobación.
text_b: Nunca borres archivos sin aprobación.

text_a: Não envie dados de clientes por correio externo.
text_b: Envie dados de clientes por correio externo.
what_differs: prohibition removed: negation dropped

text_a: Do not delete old backups without a ticket.
text_b: You need not delete old backups without a ticket.
what_differs: prohibition versus no obligation: do not delete versus need not delete

text_a: If the disk is full, notify the sysadmin.
text_b: Notify the sysadmin if the disk is full.

text_a: Envía el informe si está firmado.
text_b: Envía el informe a menos que esté firmado.
what_differs: if versus unless: the report is sent only when signed, or only when unsigned

text_a: Se o servidor cair, avise a equipe de infraestrutura.
text_b: Avise a equipe de infraestrutura se o servidor cair.

text_a: Unless the file is encrypted, upload it to the shared drive.
text_b: If the file is encrypted, upload it to the shared drive.
what_differs: unless versus if: upload applies to unencrypted files in A and encrypted files in B

text_a: Arquive vinte relatórios por mês.
text_b: Arquive 20 relatórios por mês.

text_a: Crea 1.000 usuarios de prueba.
text_b: Crea mil usuarios de prueba.

text_a: Store the 500 GB backup on drive 2.
text_b: Store the 500 MB backup on drive 2.
what_differs: GB versus MB: a thousand-fold difference in size

text_a: Mantenha o arquivo com até 2 GB.
text_b: Mantenha o arquivo com até 2.000 MB.
what_differs: 2 GB may mean 2,000 MB or 2,048 MB depending on the unit convention

text_a: Entrega el informe a más tardar el viernes.
text_b: Entrega el informe no después del viernes.

text_a: Sube los backups antes del viernes a las 18:00.
text_b: Sube los backups después del viernes a las 18:00.
what_differs: before versus after Friday

text_a: Submit the invoice by Monday at the latest.
text_b: Submit the invoice no later than Monday.

text_a: Archive the old tickets until Friday.
text_b: Archive the old tickets from Friday.
what_differs: until versus from: start or end date for archiving

text_a: Send the monthly report to the finance team.
text_b: Email the monthly report to the finance team.

text_a: Elimina los archivos temporales cada noche.
text_b: Borra los archivos temporales cada noche.

text_a: Reinicie o servidor de produção.
text_b: Recrie o servidor de produção.
what_differs: restart versus recreate: the server is rebooted in A and rebuilt from scratch in B

text_a: Crea un ticket para cada incidencia.
text_b: Genera un ticket para cada incidencia.
what_differs: create may mean by hand, generate may mean automatically; the text leaves the method open

text_a: O relatório é enviado pelo gerente toda sexta-feira.
text_b: Toda sexta-feira, o gerente envia o relatório.

text_a: Los backups son revisados por el administrador cada semana.
text_b: Cada semana, el administrador revisa los backups.

text_a: Before the server is restarted, the admin backs up the data.
text_b: After the server is restarted, the admin backs up the data.
what_differs: before versus after the restart: the backup timing is reversed

text_a: Os relatórios devem ser aprovados pelo gerente antes do envio.
text_b: O gerente deve aprovar os relatórios antes do envio, se possível.
what_differs: B adds an optional condition (se possível) that A does not state

text_a: Cada empleado debe cambiar su contraseña.
text_b: Todos los empleados deben cambiar su contraseña.

text_a: None of the files may be deleted.
text_b: No file may be deleted.

text_a: Alguns servidores precisam de reinício.
text_b: Nenhum servidor precisa de reinício.
what_differs: some versus none: some servers need a restart in A, no server does in B

text_a: Cualquier usuario puede pedir acceso.
text_b: Algún usuario puede pedir acceso.
what_differs: cualquiera (any, each) versus algún (some): readers may disagree on the intended scope
